versions.changelog:
Initial release of VexPath: a VEX-powered business operations automation skill.

- Automates email triage, inbox monitoring, lead classification, workflow design, bottleneck detection, follow-up tracking, onboarding, CRM sync, content planning, and more.
- Includes structured references and fast-access quick reference guides for email triage and onboarding.
- Defines VEX identity, core operating principles, safety rules, and decision filters for building repeatable, modular business processes.
- Outlines architecture standards, tool integrations, and required workflow components.
- Provides first-time setup checklist, output formats for triage and audits, and asset management instructions.
- Designed for direct, tactical, and efficient business operations support.
